source_ref.title_or_campaign: 현대카드 DIVE Grand Open — Let's DIVE
source_ref.production_note: DIGITAL Hyundai Card / DIVE 앱 그랜드 오픈 디지털 필름. 플랫 일러스트 2D 애니메이션. App Store·Google Play 다운로드 CTA.

target_demo: 20대~30대 초, 취향·트렌드 소비에 적극적인 MZ세대 힙스터·얼리어답터
narrative_arc: 검은 화면 → 폰 속 DIVE 앱 터치(후크 '요즘 뭐가 힙하지?') → 폰 안으로 다이브하며 스타일링 동작 몽타주 → 'Let's DIVE' 타이틀 스트로브 → 다이버가 8개 라이프스타일 콘텐츠 카테고리(고메·인테리어·디자인·여행·스타일·뮤직·테크)를 차례로 다이빙 → 모두 노란 풀에 입수(페이오프 태그라인 '취향을 업데이트하는 힙스터들의 필수 앱') → 현대카드 DIVE 그랜드 오픈 + 스토어 다운로드 마무리

production_signature.signature_note: 전 컷이 플랫 벡터 라인아트 2D 애니메이션(실사·3D 없음). 검정 윤곽선 + 비비드 팝아트 컬러(핑크·옐로·퍼플·시안). metrics wiggle(mean_abs_shift_x=5.98, sign_flips=0.245)은 wiggle_3d가 아니라 (a)컷 간 그래픽 와이프/슬라이드 전환과 (b)다이버 캐릭터의 큰 수평 이동 모션에서 나온 값으로 육안 확인됨 — 순수 렌즈 wiggle/parallax는 부재. 컷 전환은 하드컷 + 수평 그래픽 와이프(한 씬이 옆에서 밀려들어옴) 혼합. 'Let's DIVE' 타이틀은 teal↔yellow↔white 색상 스트로브 애니메이션. fps 12.0은 실제 재생 레이트(저프레임 카툰 룩).

global_layout.layout_note: 콘텐츠 카테고리 컷(8~14)은 좌측 메인 일러스트 씬 + 우측(또는 코너) 카테고리 라벨(다이아/사각 박스) + 중앙~좌측에 해시태그 말풍선/필 박스가 순차 등장하는 분할 구조. 타이틀·브랜드 컷(7·16·17)은 중앙 집중. 오프닝 폰 컷(2)은 우측 폰 + 좌측 카피.

recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: A completely black opening frame rendered at 1920x1080 pixels in a 16:9 landscape aspect ratio, used as the minimal lead-in title slate for a hip, youth-targeted Korean fintech-app motion graphic for a lifestyle content app. (1) There is no subject and no pose in this frame — it is pure environment, an empty held beat with the subject deliberately absent. (2) There is no wardrobe or material element of any kind. (3) The location reads as an abstract negative-space void rather than any built set; conceptually it is the dark threshold immediately before the viewer dives into the app's vivid illustrated world. (4) There is no foreground object and no prop — the prop list is empty and the entire 16:9 canvas is a single flat field. (5) Lighting is effectively nonexistent: the frame is a true black with no specular highlight, no ambient glow, no rim light, no practical light source, and no directional key; the key-to-fill reads as pure silhouette and the overall contrast is low-key, since the field is uniform. (6) The lens treatment is a locked-off, eye-level, frontal framing classified as an environment shot, with no camera move, no push, and no parallax. (7) The composition is dead-center and perfectly symmetrical by virtue of being empty — the subject position is center, the layout grid is center, and the negative space occupies one hundred percent of the frame. (8) The color palette and strategy are strictly monochrome: the entire frame is filled edge to edge with a single flat, pure, uniform black (hex #000000) occupying one hundred percent of the frame area as the full background black; there is no accent color, no secondary hue, and no gradient — the color relationship is monochrome, the temperature reads balanced and neutral, the saturation strategy is monochrome, and the contrast type is luminance-low. The narrative purpose of this absolute black is to set up maximum luminance contrast against the bright magenta, electric yellow, periwinkle purple and cyan pop-art color that explodes onto the screen in the very next scene; the black acts as a palette-cleanser. (9) Texture and surface across the whole frame are flat digital with zero surface detail — no vignette, no film grain, no noise, no halation, and no edge falloff whatsoever; every pixel is identical absolute black. (10) The atmosphere is a clean graphic void, weighty and minimal, holding a single quiet dramatic beat before the energetic montage begins. (11) The post and signature look follow the production signature of this film: capture style is 2D animation, the color grade is vivid-pop-flat, and the texture finish is clean-digital-flat-lineart; for this particular slate that signature manifests simply as an immaculately even flat black with no wiggle, no parallax, and no graphic wipe yet, since the strobe and wipe effects begin only in later cuts. (12) Style anchor: a minimalist Korean commercial cold-open slate — a flat digital black title card, pure negative-space lead-in, zero grain, zero gradient, high-end motion-graphic production in the clean modern register of contemporary Korean advertising. Reproduce this as an absolutely clean, uniform, flat black canvas at full HD resolution, holding still with no animation, serving as the dark threshold immediately before a vivid pop-illustration title sequence begins; the frame must contain nothing but black, and the black must be even and pure across the entire 16:9 canvas with no imperfections, no light leaks, no text, no logo, and no edge falloff of any kind.
